title: Hatchet
author: Gary Paulsen
summary: Thirteen-year-old Brian is the only passenger on a small plane when the pilot has a heart attack over the Canadian wilderness. After a crash landing in a lake, all he has is a hatchet.
readIf: you want a gripping, practical survival story that you can finish in an afternoon.
skipIf: you want romance, humour or a big cast of characters.

pairings.reason: A longer, more philosophical survival story in which a young person must keep going alone.
The classic survival-on-your-own tale that set the template for this kind of story.
Another short, plot-driven novel about a boy proving himself in a harsh landscape.
